subject: PO vs Card
message_1_body:
Hi Samantha —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call: 

1) Procurement path: you mentioned AP prefers purchase orders for vendor spend over $10k and has a standard vendor onboarding flow. Please confirm threshold and any vendor onboarding contacts.
2) Marketplace option: you said FintechCo is interested in marketplace vendors where possible. If Redwood is already listed, that speeds onboarding — otherwise the vendor setup takes longer.
3) POC commercial path: we recommended a short POC ($4.5k) to validate latency/cost on your workloads. If AP requires a PO we can support Net30 terms; otherwise we can accept card for the POC to accelerate.
4) Docs: I attached our vendor onboarding packet (W-9, SOC 2 summary, vendor form) and can surface SOW/pricing for procurement.

Next steps I suggest: 
- Samantha: please confirm AP threshold for PO vs card + the vendor onboarding contact and required docs.
- We'll send an SOW and a draft PO invoice if you need one for procurement review.

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Packet.pdf (W-9, SOC2 summary, vendor setup details)

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference
message_2_body:
Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the key procurement constraints from our side: 

- AP policy: Purchases over $10,000 require a formal PO and Net30 terms are standard. For smaller engagements (under $10k) we can usually process via corporate card.
- Vendor onboarding: We need a completed vendor setup form plus W-9, bank remit info, and our standard security attestation. A SOC 2 report or self-attestation is required for vendors with access to production data.
- Marketplace: We prefer to buy through our marketplace catalog, but the vendor must be listed. If Redwood is not listed yet, vendor onboarding typically takes 2–3 weeks.

For the POC: $4,500 via card would be easiest to get started quickly. If we need a PO for the POC, procurement will take longer but can be done; they will also want an SOW and an invoice. 

I can loop in our vendor onboarding lead once you send the completed packet and SOW.

Sam
Samantha Lee
Head of Vendor Onboarding, FintechCo
samantha.lee@fintechco.com | (212) 555-9800
